statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a known history of sick sinus syndrome
A cardiac event monitor (CPT 93271) is ordered
The monitor is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances
The monitor is ordered to evaluate for bradyarrhythmias or pauses consistent with sinus node dysfunction
Less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed inadequate prior to initiating this level of diagnostic testing
